paite: Aisan nihveina Simeon suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi. Atantuam uh Judah suante tantuam lak ah atel hi.
heading: Simeon Gam Tan
english: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

paite: Atantuam ding ua pukte Beer-sheba, Sheba, Moladah,
english: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

paite: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
english: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

paite: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

paite: Ziklag, Beth-markaboth. Hazar-susah,
english: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

paite: Beth-lebaoth leh Sharuhen; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-thum ahi.
english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

paite: Ain, Rimmon, Ether leh Ashan: akhotate toh khopi li.
english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

paite: Huai khopi kim akhopel tengteng Baalath-beer simlam a Ramah apha hi. Huaite Simeon suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a amau tantuam dia seh ahi.
english: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

paite: Simeon suante tantuam Judah suante tantuam lak a ahi. Judah suante tantuam amau a ding in aza lo ngal a; huaiziak in Simeon suante tantuam lak ah atel hi.
english: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

paite: Aisan thumveina Zebulun suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi. Atantuam gamgi uh Sarid tan ahi.
heading: Zebulun Gam Tan
english: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

paite: Agamgi uh tumlam pang ah Maralah pha in apai a, Dabeseth ava tung a; Jokneam kiang a luita tan ava tung hi.
english: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

paite: Sarid a pan suahlam pang nisuahna lam ah Kisloth-tabor gamgi pha in akawitou a; Daberath ah apawt hi.
english: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

paite: Huai a pan suahlam pang ah Gittah-hepher leh Eth-kazin ah apai zel a, Neah lam zuan in Rimmon ah apawt hi.
english: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

paite: Mallam ah Hannathon ah akualphei nawn a, apawtna Iphtah-el Phaizang ah ahi.
english: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

paite: Katath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah leh Bethlehem; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm- le-nih ahi.
english: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

paite: Hiaite ahi Zebulun suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a, atantuam ding ua seh; huai khopite leh khopelte toh.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

paite: Aisan liveina Issakar suante tung ah a-inkuan uh omdan dungzui in apuk hi.
heading: Issakar Gam Tan
english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

paite: Agamgi chiang uh Jezreel, Kesuloth, Shunem,
english: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

paite: Haphraim, Shion, Anaharath,
english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

paite: Rabbith, Kishion, Abez,
english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

paite: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah leh Beth-pazzez tan ahi.
english: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

paite: Tabor, Shahazimah leh Beth-shemesh ava pha a; apawtna Jordan ah ahi a, akhopel teng toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-guk ahi,
english: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

paite: Hiaite ahi Issakar suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, atantuam ding ua seh; khopite leh akhotate toh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

paite: Aisan ngana Asher suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
heading: Asher Gam Tan
english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

paite: Gamgi chiang Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,
english: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

paite: Allammelek, Amad leh Mishal ahi a; tumlam pang ah Karmel tang leh Shihor-libnath aphasuk hi.
english: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

paite: Nisuahna lam pang ah Beth-dagon akualtou a, Zebulun leh mallam pang ah Jiphthah-el Phaizang ah Beth-emek leh Neiel ava pha a; veilam ah Kabul pha in apai a,
english: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

paite: Ebron leh Rehob, Hammon leh Kanah, Zidon thupi pha in apai zel hi.
english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

paite: Gamgi Ramah leh Tura khopi kulhbaang nei ah akualphei a, Hosah ah akualphei nawn a, Akzib gam tuipi ah apawt hi.
english: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

paite: Ummah, Aphek leh Rehob; akhopel teng toh khopi tengteng sawmnih-le-nih ahi.
english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

paite: Huaite ahi Asher suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, khopite leh akhotate atantuam uh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

paite: Aisan gukna Naphtali suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
heading: Naphtali Gam Tan
english: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

paite: Agamgi chiang uh Heleph leh Zaananim a singkung lianpi a pan Adami-nekeb, Jabneel leh Lakkum pha in apai a, Jordan ah atawp hi.
english: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

paite: Tumlam pang ah Aznoth-tabor ah apaisuk a; huai a pan Hukok ah apai a, simlam ah Zebulun ava tung a, tumlam ah Asher atung a, nisuahna lam ah Judia gam a Jordan aphatou hi.
english: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

paite: Khopi kulhbaang neite: Ziddim, Zer, Hamath, Rakkath, Kinneret,
english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

paite: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

paite: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
english: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

paite: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath leh Beth-shemesh ahi a, akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm ahi.
english: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

paite: Hiaite ahi Naphtali suante nam a-inkuan dungzui ua khopite leh akhotate atantuam uh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

paite: Aisan sagihna Dan suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
heading: Dan Gam Tan
english: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

paite: Atantuam gamgi uh Zorah, Estaol leh Ir-shemesh,
english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

paite: Shaalabbin, Aijalon leh Jethlah,
english: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

paite: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
english: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

paite: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

paite: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
english: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

paite: Me-jarkon, Rakkon leh Joppa kiang a gamgi toh.
english: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

paite: Dan suante gamgi in huaite ava kheng a; Dan suante'n Lesem adou ua, ala ua, namsau in ahihmang ua, atangta uh. Huai ah ateng pah ua, apu uh Dan min tam in Lesem, Dan ana chi uhi.
english: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

paite: Hiaite ahi Dan suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, huai khopi leh akhotate toh atantuam uh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

paite: Huchi in atantuam ding ua gamgi bawl bang zel a gam ahawm khit un, Israel suante'n Nun tapa Joshua alak uah tantuam abawlsak uhi.
heading: Gam Hawmna Nanung
english: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

paite: TOUPA thupiak bang in Ephraim singtang gam a, akhopi ding in anget mah Timnath-serah apia ua; ama'n khopi asat a, huai ah ateng hi.
english: According to Yahweh’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

paite: Hiaite ahi siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel suante nam inkuan a lupente'n Shiloh a TOUPA ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a ai san a, agoutan ding ua ana hawmte uh. Huchi in gam kihawm azouta uhi.
english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
